human-heart-rate.description: Median embryonic heart rate by gestational week (Ouyang et al. 2020). heart_rate_at() places the median of week w at w + offset, the middle of the completed week it is taken to cover (the model assumption bio:HEART-RATE-WEEK-PLACEMENT), and interpolates linearly between neighbouring medians.
human-heart-rate.at: gestational week, as the paper labels it

human-cleavage.description: Mean time from insemination until the embryo reaches each number of cells from 2 to 8 (Lorenzo Rodríguez et al. 2026). cell_count_at() is the step function over these times.
